referenceTape: 3M Scotch 202/203, the tape the 3M M56 manual recommends. Used as a benchmark only; this is not a claim of equivalence to that product.
status: documentation-derived; not validated against tape; not listened to

evidence.coatingThicknessMicrons: assumed: half a mil of oxide; no data sheet for this tape was read
evidence.molDb: derived: the 3M M56 manual gives 3 percent third harmonic at 1 kHz with the linearizer off at +10 dBm on its recommended tape, taken here as 6 dB over operating level. A 1974 trade article puts the next two 3M tapes 3 dB and 6 dB higher, which fits
evidence.overbias: published: 3M M56 manual, 4 dB overbias at 15 kHz at 15 in/s
